subject: POC hands-on lab: orchestration runbook, scheduling update & pre-reads
raw:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@brightpath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC hands-on lab — proposed dates + pre-read bundle

Hi Alex / Sana,

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on session for the Redwood POC. We want to make the lab high-impact for your ML/infra team — covering prompt review, routing strategies, and performing a brief load run to validate throughput expectations.

Proposed 2.5-hour slots (Pacific):
- Thu Jun 10, 10:00–12:30
- Wed Jun 16, 13:00–15:30

If neither works we can do a shorter 90-minute focused session (prompt + routing) and follow up with a dedicated load window.

Pre-reads (attached):
- poc_runbook_v1.pdf (session outline + roles)
- prompt-review-checklist.md (suggested prompts + acceptance criteria)
- lab-load-plan-202706.csv (sample traffic profile for a 15-minute load test)

Please confirm preferred slot and who from your side will join (eng, infra, SRE). We’ll finalize agenda and send a calendar invite with Zoom + shared Drive materials.

Best,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai

---

From: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@brightpath.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Khan <sana.khan@brightpath.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC hands-on lab — proposed dates + pre-read bundle

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the detailed pack. Jun 10 conflicts with a company all-hands; Jun 16 looks good for most of our team. Can we shift to 12:30–15:00 PT instead? That gives our East-coast folks enough overlap.

Attendees likely: Alex (eng lead), Sana (SRE), Priya Mehta (data platform), and an external contractor for our API gateway.

Also: could you call out which parts of the runbook require elevated access (network/SG changes)? We may need to loop security.

— Alex

---

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@brightpath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC hands-on lab — proposed dates + pre-read bundle

Great — thanks for the headcount and timing. Jun 16 12:30–15:00 PT works. We’ll update the invite.

Quick notes on elevated access:
- The short load window will use a test token and SSH-forwarded agent; no permanent SG changes required.
- If you want to test direct peering or private VPC endpoints we’ll need a short maintenance window and network ACLs; that’s optional for this session.
- Security-sensitive steps are flagged in poc_runbook_v1.pdf under section 4 (Network & Keys).

Action items before session:
- BrightPath: confirm final attendee list + internal approver for any network changes (Sana?)
- Redwood: produce runbook v1 -> v2 with gating checklist and shared Drive link (Marissa will own)
- Dev: prepare a short load harness and sample traffic profile that matches lab-load-plan-202706.csv

I’ll send the updated agenda and invite by EOD.

Best,
Jasmine

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@brightpath.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Updated agenda + pre-read link for Jun 16 lab (12:30–15:00 PT)

Hi Alex / team — attaching an updated agenda and the v2 runbook. High level plan below: 

Agenda (2.5 hr) — Jun 16, 12:30–15:00 PT
1) 12:30–12:40 — Intros & goals (Jasmine)
2) 12:40–13:10 — Prompt review & quality criteria (Marissa) — please mark any example prompts in the checklist we should prioritize
3) 13:10–13:40 — Routing & inference topology (Karthik) — discuss model variants and fallback policies
4) 13:40–14:10 — Short load run (Dev) — 15-minute traffic profile followed by a 10-minute analysis window
5) 14:10–14:35 — Latency/cost trade-offs & quantization notes (Marissa)
6) 14:35–14:55 — Action plan & next steps (all)
7) 14:55–15:00 — Quick wrap / feedback capture

Pre-read (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cbpoc-runbook
Attachments: poc_runbook_v2.pdf (attached), prompt-review-checklist.md, lab-load-plan-202706.csv

Please review the prompt checklist ahead of time and add any sample payloads to the shared folder by Jun 14. If you expect to test VPC endpoints, flag that now so we can schedule a short network call before the lab.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment stubs: poc_runbook_v2.pdf (application/pdf), prompt-review-checklist.md (text/markdown), lab-load-plan-202706.csv (text/csv)

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Ramirez <alex.ramirez@brightpath.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated agenda + pre-read link for Jun 16 lab (12:30–15:00 PT)

All set on our side. A couple of implementation notes before the load run: 
- I’ll provision the test harness in our staging cluster and push the traffic driver to the shared Drive by EOD Jun 9.
- The CSV includes burst pattern 3 which ramps to 180 rps; recommend we start with pattern 1 (steady 60 rps) and step up if BrightPath is comfortable.
- If we see auth failures we’ll fall back to request-level throttling to preserve the runtime SLOs.

Alex — if Priya or your SRE would like to pre-run the traffic driver from an internal host, let me know the IP ranges and I’ll open limited ingress for the 15-minute window.

See you on Jun 16.

— Dev
